questions.stem: Two buses depart from the same stop. Bus A departs every $12$ minutes and Bus B every $18$ minutes. If both leave at 9:00 am, when will they next depart together?
questions.explanation: We need the LCM of $12$ and $18$. $12 = 2^2 \times 3$ and $18 = 2 \times 3^2$. LCM $= 2^2 \times 3^2 = 36$ minutes. So they next depart together at 9:36 am.
